what do I notice about the data?

the covariate data has one subject per row and the columns are the covariates (long data)
the data is character strings, will need to remove text and keep numerical values
will also need to code for preeclampsia vs. normal and asthmatic vs. healthy
no missing values

the gene expression data has one subject per column, the rows are the probe ids (wide data)
data is numerical, each column matches a geoid from covariate data (how to match the data)

the gene name data has the gene name corresponding to the probe id (how to match the data)

will need to pivot expression data to be longer



## Cleaning data 


```{r}
# clean covariate data to remove labels 
# update data types
# 0 = healthy, 1= asthmatic (should I replace num with char?, maybe down the road)
# batch date is still char

covariate_cleaned <- covariate_data %>% 
  mutate(
    mat_age_yrs = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_age_yrs, ".*: ")),
    preg_preeclampsia = str_remove(preg_preeclampsia, ".*: "),
    delivery_gestAge_wks = as.numeric(str_remove(delivery_gestAge_wks, ".*: ")),
    sampleCollection_gestAge_wks = as.numeric(str_remove(sampleCollection_gestAge_wks, ".*: ")),
    batch_Microarray = (str_remove(batch_Microarray, ".*: ")),
    mat_BMI = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_BMI, ".*: ")),
    mat_vitD = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_vitD, ".*: ")),
    mat_asthma = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_asthma, ".*: "))
  )

head(covariate_cleaned)

```



Pivot gene expression data longer

```{r}
# pivot gene expression data, rename x to probe id for future join

gene_expression_long <- gene_expression_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:158,
      names_to = "geoID",
    values_to = "expression value") %>% 
  rename(PROBEID = X)
head(gene_expression_long)


# join covariate and expression data on geoid,  join gene name on probe id 
pregnancy_data <- gene_expression_long %>% 
  left_join(covariate_cleaned, by = "geoID") %>% 
  left_join(gene_names, by = "PROBEID")

head(pregnancy_data)

## for tomorrow, I want to move gene name to column before expression value

```
